titulo.estudio: Un itinéraire modifié : Repérer les informations
titulo.alumno: A changed journey: Finding the details

intro: Understand a change of transport and find the practical consequence for the trip. Read the French first; open the translation whenever you want to check your understanding.

frases.estudio: En raison d'un incident, le train pour Dijon partira avec vingt minutes de retard.
frases.alumno: Because of an incident, the train to Dijon will leave twenty minutes late.

frases.estudio: La correspondance de 14 h 10 est donc impossible; un autre train part à 15 h.
frases.alumno: So you will not be able to catch the 14:10 connection; another train leaves at 15:00.

texto: Understand a change of transport and find the practical consequence for the trip. Match the subject with the request and check the dates, conditions and actions the message asks you to carry out.
Watch out: « À cause de » introduces the cause; « donc » and « en revanche » link its consequences. In this passage, «retard» means «delay».
